Build, publish and document the <NAME> sample app v<VERSION>, against the agreed scope.

See the [Sample Apps process](https://ecosystem.logos.co/sample_apps) for the full expectations and rationale behind each deliverable.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] **Build**: sample app built against scope, in a public repo with the right licensing.
- [ ] **Publish**: module published to the Eco Dev Eng Logos module repo (repo: _TBD_).
- [ ] **ADRs** (Architecture Decision Records) in an `ADR.md`, _must be team reviewed_
- [ ] **Dependencies**: components and design patterns used, in a `Dependencies` section of `README.md`
- [ ] **Document**: doc-packet filed via the [logos-docs doc-packet template](https://github.com/logos-co/logos-docs/issues/new?template=doc-packet.yml), _docs must be team reviewed_
